title: General Manager
description:
Overview

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of the city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands-on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship-building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long-term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision-making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world-class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure

The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications

Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:

  1. 1. Act with an open mindset:

    Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning. Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model. Build quality relationships with the management team. Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak-up" culture.

  2. 2. Create positive impact working with others:

    Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect. Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input. Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision-making processes. Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well-being of colleagues.

  3. 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:

    Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards. Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations. Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty. Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.

  4. 4. Consistently deliver excellence:

    Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets. Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel. Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market. Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan. Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.

  5. 5. Enable team success:

    Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning. Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities. Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement. Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures. As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.

  6. 6. Create clarity:

    Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy. Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members. Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process. Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem-solving.

  7. 7. Inspire for top performance:

    Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best. Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements. Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks. Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition. Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents. Champions a "speak-up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated. Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win-win solutions.

Additional Information

Prior experience in a luxury hotel General Manager position, in large hotel(s) (mandatory)

Strong educational background with professional qualifications and a continuous learning mindset.

Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)

Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)

Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture

Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high-performing cultures.

Experience in managing owner relations.

Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills.

Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.

Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit

Bottom-line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team-building.

Creative and innovative mindset.

Ability to collaborate and work in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent sense of prioritization and time management.

Professional demeanor and strategic orientation.

Engaging, friendly, and charismatic with a natural ability to connect with guests.

Passionate about creating memorable experiences and turning moments into memories

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

At Amazon, we are committed to being the safest place to work in the world, the best employer, and the most customer-centric company. The generalist role in HR will involve staffing and workforce management in different hiring formats, internal communication and employee engagement, leadership development at supervisor to managerial levels, general coordination of labor and employee relations issues, consolidation and reporting of metrics (absenteeism, attrition, fill rates), indirect coordination of shuttle transportation and restaurant, continuous improvement plans for employee experience, Diversity and Inclusion programs, among others.

  • Conduct "Gemba" and monitor operational processes in the "shop-floor".

  • Train, develop, and support leadership through decision-making.
  • Collaborate with various levels of the organization, from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  • Influence and guide partners to prioritize employee experience and customer obsession.
About the team

We could be a great match if you:

  • Are excited to work in a fast-paced and team-oriented environment.
  • Are enthusiastic about working in a production environment (logistics warehouse) engaging our teams, training our leaders, and creating the best place in the world to work.
  • Are excited about generalist positions where each day you will deal with various Human Resources topics.
  • Are enthusiastic about flexing your routine when necessary, making room to occasionally work night shifts or weekends, in an operation that runs 24/7 every day of the year.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

title: SELECIONADOR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Realizar processos de Recrutamento e Seleção para profissionais de todas as categorias, obedecendo aos métodos adotados pela Instituição.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Gestão de RH ou Superior cursando a partir do 5° semestre em Psicologia;

Buscamos um(a) Museólogo(a) , para atuar em conservação e pesquisa do acervo museológico do Clube de Regatas do Flamengo.   • Acervos em itinerância: Acompanhar deslocamento de acervo museológico, em transporte, e montagem e desmontagem de exposições fora da instituição. Com disponibilidade para viagens, caso necessário.
Requirements and skills
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Museologia;
  • Experiência com documentação museológica.
  • Experiência com pesquisa museológica.

title: Supervisor de Área
description:
Supervisor de Área – Grupo Lothar Descreva a Vaga

É responsável por visitar os postos conforme a rota definida, verificando a presença, postura, uniforme e equipamentos dos vigilantes, assegurando o cumprimento das normas operacionais estabelecidas. Também acompanha as escalas de trabalho, confirma a presença dos profissionais nos turnos e providencia coberturas em casos de faltas ou atrasos, realizando os devidos ajustes conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Entre suas atribuições está a aplicação de treinamentos práticos e rápidos no próprio local de trabalho (on-the-job), com foco na correção de falhas e reforço dos procedimentos de segurança. Além disso, é responsável por preencher checklists operacionais, relatar ocorrências, irregularidades e comunicar qualquer anormalidade à central ou à gerência.

Realiza vistorias nos equipamentos utilizados pelos vigilantes, como rádios comunicadores, lanternas, sistemas de CFTV e alarmes, garantindo que todos estejam funcionando corretamente e que os profissionais estejam com os EPIs e materiais exigidos para a função.

Durante ocorrências, o supervisor presta apoio direto à equipe, atuando em casos como invasões, furtos ou acidentes, acionando as autoridades competentes quando necessário e registrando os fatos de forma clara e precisa.

Mantém contato frequente com os responsáveis nos locais de vigilância, avaliando a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados e repassando os feedbacks à gestão. Além disso, realiza inspeções surpresa para verificar a conduta dos vigilantes, o cumprimento de horários e a execução correta das rotinas nos postos.

WHY JOIN US

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager with 3+ years of experience to connect prospective clients and internal teams. You will lead discovery sessions, capture key details like timelines and budgets, and turn insights into clear, high‑impact proposals. Strong knowledge of business strategy, the SDLC, and excellent communication skills are essential.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
  • Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement:
    • Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information following internal RACI procedures.
    • Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly.
    • Demonstrate in‑depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception, through discovery and development, to market release—to guide discussions and identify project feasibility.
    • Use consultative questioning techniques to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high‑level requirements such as project timeline, budget constraints, technical skill requirements, and risk assessments.
    • Showcase strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client‑facing interactions, both during calls and via emails.
  • Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation:
    • Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations.
    • Customize deliverables to reflect client‑specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings.
    • Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long‑term client growth.
  • Team Buildout and Project Kickoff:
    • Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand‑offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick‑off.
    • Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding.
    • Serve as a trusted advisor during pre‑sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business‑focused narratives.
    • Maintain a sales/consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.
MUST HAVES
  • 3+ years of experience in similar Sales & Delivery Management roles.
  • Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client‑facing interactions.
  • UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high‑quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
  • Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes.
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams.
  • Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre‑sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top‑tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Job Description

We are looking for a Web Analyst to join our team and help us optimize the performance of over 25 B2B websites. As a key member for the web team, you will be responsible for analyzing user behaviour, tracking key website metrics, and providing actionable insights to improve MQL generation and conversion rates. Your work will directly impact our ability to make informed decisions and improve the performance of our websites.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze, and report on website performance, focusing on conversion rates, form submissions, and user engagement.
  • Interpret data from website tracking tools (Google Analytics, VWO, Hubspot).
  • Setting and ideation for web events based on business objectives.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards to provide real‑time insights into website performance and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations for the marketing team (LookerStudio, Superset).
  • Conducting A/B testing analyses (VWO and HubSpot).
  • One‑off analysis for key initiatives like Back Friday campaign, promotions, product launches, website migrations to measure effectiveness.
  • Identify and analyse different audience segments to improve targeting and personalisation.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to ensure that tracking plans are in place for all key user behaviours.
  • Collaborate with the content team to provide data‑driven insights that inform content creation and optimise engagement from key user segments.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years experience in web analytics, digital marketing, or CRO roles.
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or other web analytics platforms.
  • Ability to build dashboards and reports using Looker, Tableau, Superset or similar tools.
  • Experience with A/B testing tools like Google Optimize, VWO, or Optimizely.
  • Experience with Hotjar, Clarity, or other user behaviour tracking tools.
  • Experience with Search Console or other SEO tracking tools is a plus.
  • Experience working in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.
Hiring Process
  1. Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Acquisition Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

Suas principais atividades serão:
  • Aplicar os conhecimentos técnicos de Segurança do Trabalho de modo a reduzir, neutralizar ou eliminar os riscos à segurança do trabalhador;
  • Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;
  • Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa e determinar fatores de riscos de acidentes;

  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);
  • Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;

  • Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;
  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;
  • Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;
  • Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis;
  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;
  • Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;
  • Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! title: Consultor(a) SAP PLM
description:

title: Technical Support Engineer (Mid-Level)
description:
Technical Support Engineer (Mid-Level)

Location: Remote (Brazil. or Latin America preferred)

Company: Hitch, Inc.


About Hitch

Hitch builds the digital infrastructure powering modern home equity and non-QM lending. Our white-label platform enables lenders to launch HELOC, DSCR, bridge, and home equity products faster — with integrated point of sale, broker portals, and automated underwriting.

We partner with leading mortgage lenders like Deephaven Mortgage and MyEQNow to deliver a seamless borrower and broker experience.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Technical Support Engineer to join our operations and product team. You will act as the primary technical contact for our clients — diagnosing platform issues, tracing bugs, and communicating findings clearly between client operations teams and Hitch’s engineers.

This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer experience and technology.


Responsibilities
  • Serve as Tier 2 support for lender and broker clients, escalating bugs and complex issues to engineering when needed.
  • Investigate client-reported issues by analyzing logs, API requests, database records, and user behavior.
  • Reproduce and document bugs with clear replication steps, timestamps, and expected vs. actual results.
  • Collaborate with developers and QA to verify fixes and regression-test key features.
  • Use tools like Postman, AWS CloudWatch, and browser developer tools to debug integrations.
  • Maintain support documentation, internal runbooks, and root-cause analyses.
  • Monitor application health metrics and proactively identify potential system issues.
  • Participate in weekly technical support syncs with Product and Engineering.


Requirements
  • 2–5 years of experience in technical support, QA engineering, or DevOps support for SaaS or fintech platforms.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication (C1 or native-level).
  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads , and browser console/network tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret basic SQL queries or error logs .
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when documenting issues.
  • Experience with ticketing systems (Zendesk, Linear, Asana, or Jira).
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with developers and client success teams.


Nice-to-Have
  • Background in mortgage, lending, or real estate technology (LOS, POS, or Encompass integration).
  • Knowledge of AWS , Node.js , or React debugging.
  • Experience working with Plaid, Truework, Prudent AI, or other fintech APIs .
  • Portuguese or Spanish proficiency (to collaborate with our Brazil-based engineering team).


Why Hitch
  • Work closely with a global engineering team building the future of digital lending.
  • Exposure to real-world integrations across fintech, credit, and mortgage ecosystems.
  • Growth opportunities into QA, DevOps, or Client Success Engineering.
  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

title: Especialista DevOps Sênior (Cloud & IA)
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Como Especialista DevOps Sênior Cloud & IA, você será a peça-chave na evolução da infraestrutura que suporta nossa plataforma de IA . Sua missão abrangerá três pilares centrais: a migração estratégica de nossos serviços da Azure para a AWS; a otimização de performance e custos (FinOps) em ambientes Kubernetes; e a implementação de infraestrutura para processamento de IA open-source na AWS. Esta é uma função crítica que exige profundo conhecimento técnico em operações de nuvem, segurança (DevSecOps) e um interesse genuíno no emergente campo de AIOps.


Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, executar e validar a migração completa da infraestrutura de cloud, movendo as cargas de trabalho da Azure para a AWS, garantindo mínima disrupção e máxima eficiência.
  • Assumir a arquitetura e customização do ambiente Kubernetes (K8s), assegurando a escalabilidade e resiliência da plataforma "Pullse".
  • Implementar e otimizar técnicas avançadas de auto-scaling, utilizando HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaler) e KEDA (Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling) para responder dinamicamente às cargas de trabalho de IA.
  • Estruturar e operar a infraestrutura para processamento de modelos de IA open-source, utilizando AWS Bedrock como serviço gerenciado principal.
  • Aplicar rigorosas práticas de DevSecOps, com foco na gestão e rotação de secrets (segredos) em ambientes de contêineres.
  • Gerenciar e manter o AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização de usuários na plataforma.
  • Implementar estratégias de FinOps, focando na otimização agressiva de custos através do uso e gerenciamento de instâncias Spot (EC2 Spot).


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) DevOps ou SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.
  • Profundo conhecimento do ecossistema AWS (VPC, EC2, S3, IAM, EKS) e experiência prática com AWS Cognito.
  • Experiência sólida em migração de infraestrutura entre provedores de nuvem (especificamente Azure para AWS).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) , especificamente Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation.
  • Domínio de Kubernetes (K8s), incluindo arquitetura, deployments, networking e segurança de clusters.
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de aplicações em K8s utilizando Helm e Kustomize.
  • Experiência prática na implementação de soluções de auto-scaling (HPA e/ou KEDA).
  • Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) aplicadas a ambientes distribuídos.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DevSecOps, notadamente na gestão de secrets (ex: AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).
  • Experiência em AWS Bedrock ou serviços equivalentes para operações de modelos de IA.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência avançada em FinOps, com histórico comprovado de otimização de custos em nuvem (especialmente com instâncias Spot).
  • Certificações relevantes (ex: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Certified Kubernetes Administrator - CKA).
  • Experiência anterior com ferramentas de orquestração de IA ou plataformas de MLOps.

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

description:

Com escritórios em 4 países, ajudamos bancos, seguradoras, gestoras de fundos, fundos de pensão, corretoras de valores e outras instituições a enfrentarem os desafios mais complexos de hoje e do futuro com uma solução moderna.   • Oferecer apoio e liderança à equipe de desenvolvimento e garantir o cumprimento das políticas e procedimentos padrão da empresa relativos ao processo de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Head of Engineering para cumprir com as funções da área.

Requisitos do cargo:

  • Formação superior em Redes de Computadores, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software.
  • Sólidas habilidades comprovadas em engenharia de software.
  • Habilidades comprovadas em desenvolvimento de software robusto.

  • 5 anos de experiência profissional comprovada no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando plataformas Java e Java EE.
  • Experiência com IDE Eclipse, XML, GIT e Git Flow.

  • Experiência com soluções SaaS.
  • Sólido conhecimento em JAX-WS e JAX-RS.

Desejáveis:

  • Certificação Java OCA – OCP.
  • Conhecimento em instrumentos financeiros.
  • Conhecimento em Vaadin.

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Job Title: Data Quality Analyst

Purpose:

The Data Quality Analyst is responsible for auditing and testing enterprise applications with a focus on backend ETL (Extract, Transform & Load) processes and other software modules related to the creation of data warehouse reporting instruments , ensuring high-quality and reliable information. This role also involves creating ad-hoc queries to extract information from reporting sources as requested by business areas.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Follow established quality assurance standards and processes .
  • Determine and implement methods, flows, and procedures to improve QA and business processes.
  • Create and document test scripts to audit data integrity on an ongoing basis.
  • Test newly developed applications by creating test scenarios and verifying compliance with business requirements.
  • Analyze and resolve application and data issues as they arise.
  • Document production processes and objects for better understanding across IT and business users.
  • Handle ad-hoc data warehouse queries for end users as needed.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related business discipline from an accredited institution; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Data Quality Assurance , preferably in data warehousing or reporting environments .
  • At least 2 years of QA testing experience , ideally in data integrity assessment .
  • Preferably 2+ years of experience in the travel industry .
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities.

Technical Skills:

  • SQL and PL/SQL (Oracle platform preferred).
  • Strong understanding of ETL processes (Extract, Transform, Load).
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and architectures.
  • Experience creating and executing test scripts for data validation.
  • Strong data analysis and troubleshooting skills with large datasets.
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (tables, indexes, triggers, etc.).
  • Familiarity with reporting/BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, OBIEE, Cognos).
  • Intermediate English level (B2) – strong written and verbal communication required.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in team environments .
  • Capable of managing multiple projects and shifting priorities effectively.

Benefits:

  • Career development plan and continuous training opportunities.
  • Excellent work environment with flexibility.
  • Direct benefits from the client.
  • 100% remote work , or hybrid mode if you are based in Medellín.
  • A workplace where professional growth meets quality of life .
  • More than just a job offer – this is a life experience where you can grow professionally while enjoying a flexible, dynamic, and challenging environment .

title: Web Producer / QA
description:
Web Producer / QA

Please make sure to submit your resume in English, it will not be accepted otherwise. The interview process will also be conducted in English.


Smart Age Solutions is a Digital Marketing agency located in New York with a branch in Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for new talents in Brazil who would like to build a career at an American Company!

Here at Smart Age, we offer a wide range of results-driven services and don’t settle for less-than-optimum quality. Smart Age is the only Google Premier Partner and META Preferred Partner in the jewelry industry. We create precise, fully customizable strategies across Google Search, Social Media, SEO, Retargeting, Display, and Email Marketing to maximize conversions. Our team of industry experts helps businesses succeed in an increasingly digital world by using practices and platforms that deliver results today while planning for what’s coming tomorrow.


Job Overview:

We are seeking a Web Producer / QA to join our growing Web Team. This role will focus on implementing site updates, performing quality assurance checks after development, and ensuring our clients’ websites maintain the highest standards of accuracy and usability. The ideal candidate should have a keen eye for detail, excellent organizational skills, and a solid foundation in HTML and CSS. Experience with Shopify is strongly preferred, with occasional work in Magento and WordPress.


Responsibilities:

  • Execute updates on client websites, including content changes, product uploads, and page adjustments.
  • Perform thorough QA testing after development to ensure websites function properly across devices and browsers.
  • Identify and document bugs or inconsistencies and collaborate with developers to resolve issues.
  • Maintain visual and functional consistency across web pages, ensuring alignment with client brand guidelines.
  • Assist in content migration and site launches, verifying layouts, links, and responsiveness.
  • Support the Web Project Manager and Development team with ongoing website maintenance.
  • Stay up to date with web best practices, accessibility standards, and emerging technologies.


Qualifications:

  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • 1–2 years of professional experience in web production, QA, or a related field.
  • Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS (ability to troubleshoot and make minor adjustments).
  • Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Shopify experience is required. Familiarity with Magento and WordPress is a plus.
  • Experience with QA methodologies and cross-browser/device testing tools is preferred.
  • Team player who is proactive and eager to learn.


Software & Tools:

  • Shopify (primary) / Magento / WordPress
  • Jira (task management)
  • Slack (team communication)
  • Google Docs / Sheets / Drive


Working Hours:

  • 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (BRT), Monday through Friday


Join us in shaping the future of global digital innovation! We embrace diversity and inclusion, valuing talent and passion above all else. Don’t miss out on this exciting opportunity to contribute to the success of high-end brands and grow with an innovative and collaborative team. Apply now and let’s embark on this journey together!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java – Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora Backend com sólida experiência em Java e arquitetura de microserviços, que também tenha forte senso de colaboração e comunicação para atuar em projetos de alta complexidade e impacto.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, busca excelência técnica, gosta de trabalhar em equipe e está sempre em busca de melhorias contínuas, essa vaga é para você!

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações backend escaláveis, performáticas e seguras, utilizando Java 8+.
  • Projetar e manter microserviços com Spring Boot, aplicando boas práticas e padrões de projeto.
  • Participar da definição e evolução de arquitetura de sistemas, com foco em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Criar, manter e consumir APIs RESTful seguras e eficientes.
  • Atuar em pipelines de CI/CD, automação e deploy com ferramentas como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, etc).
  • Colaborar com as equipes de QA, DevOps e outros desenvolvedores em revisões de código e definições técnicas.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos sistemas existentes, priorizando performance e manutenibilidade.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente colegas de equipe, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java (Java 8+).
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microserviços e uso de Spring Boot.
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem pública (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência com containers (Docker) e orquestração com Kubernetes.
  • Prática com CI/CD e automação de deploys.
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e cultura de qualidade de código.
  • Boa comunicação para interações com times técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe, senso de ownership e postura colaborativa.

Diferenciais

  • Participação em projetos de larga escala.
  • Certificações em nuvem ou em Java/Spring.


Localidade | Atuação

Uberlândia/MG: Presencial

São Paulo/SP: Híbrido (2x na semana no escritório)

Demais localidades: Remoto

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack Sênior
description:
Missão do cargo:

Ser referência técnica e de negócio dentro do time de Integrações da Plataforma RH da TOTVs.

Participar de projetos de média e alta complexidade, que resolvam o desafio de integração entre os produtos TOTVs e também entre o ecossistema e os parceiros externos. Agregar valor ao produto e contribuir na evolução profissional do time.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

● Realizar manutenções, implementações ou serviços de média/alta complexidade, com baixo nível de supervisão e pouco apoio, que envolvam regras de negócios, através da implementação de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias PHP, Node.js, React e outros;

● Conhecer a fundo arquitetura do software e ser capaz de atuar nela por meio da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;

● Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado das funcionalidades desenvolvidas utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes do time;

● Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro do desenvolvimento nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;

● Orientar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho, por meio da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;

● Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;

● Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;

● Detalhar requisitos de média e alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação: Superior completo em tecnologia e afins.
  • Conhecimentos específicos:
  • Integração de dados (APIs, mensagerias, etc);
  • Lógica de Programação;
  • Banco de Dados – nível avançado;
  • Domínio de linguagem de programação (principalmente PHP, Node.js e React/Next.js);
  • Fundamento em testes unitários – nível avançado;
  • Arquitetura de Software – nível intermediário;
  • Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Vivência SaaS.
  • Experiência com Kafka, Redis, NSQ, …
  • Experiência com Docker.
  • Diferencial:
  • Conhecimento prévio de regras de negócio de produtos RH.
